# free-recipe-api-mcp — install (generated by w2mcp)

```bash
npm i @modelcontextprotocol/sdk zod
FREE_RECIPE_API_TOKEN=your_token  node --loader tsx server.ts
```

mcp.json (local / stdio):
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "free-recipe-api": { "command": "node", "args": ["--loader","tsx","/path/to/server.ts"], "env": { "FREE_RECIPE_API_TOKEN": "your_token" } } } }
```

Remote / hosted (Streamable HTTP) — agent connects to a URL instead of launching a process:
```bash
MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=3000 FREE_RECIPE_API_TOKEN=your_token  node --loader tsx server.ts
# → POST http://<host>:3000/mcp   (stateless; single-tenant: token from env)
```

Tools: `free-recipe-api.search_meal_by_name`, `free-recipe-api.list_meals_by_first_letter`, `free-recipe-api.lookup_meal_details_by_id`, `free-recipe-api.lookup_single_random_meal`, `free-recipe-api.lookup_selection_of_random_meals`, `free-recipe-api.list_all_meal_categories`, `free-recipe-api.list_latest_meals`, `free-recipe-api.list_categories`, `free-recipe-api.list_areas`, `free-recipe-api.list_ingredients`, `free-recipe-api.filter_by_main_ingredient`, `free-recipe-api.filter_by_multi_ingredient`, `free-recipe-api.filter_by_category`, `free-recipe-api.filter_by_area`
